C1131.title: Grandpa Fang Scammed by AI-Cloned Comrade’s Voice
C1131.summary: While walking in a park, Grandpa Fang received a call from someone claiming to be his comrade Lao Qiao, who said he was ill and urgently needed funds. Fang believed the caller and transferred 2,000 yuan and then 8,000 yuan. After the money arrived, Lao Qiao disappeared and Fang realized he had been defrauded. The current source supports an acquaintance-impersonation phone scam, but does not sufficiently confirm use of AI-generated comrade voice.

references.title: Beijing Fengtai District Government: Telecom Fraud Types Targeting Older Adults
